title: S5R-D05: a write-off lets the order cancel and refuses the shipment; a confirmation that commits first still leaves the approval standing
deviations: The confirmation-first gap R13 reports is shown, not closed: after shipment.gap of 60 committed, PUR approved a write-off of 50 of the 100 verified. PUR reads no shipment.
